pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, dark brown polygons with high-contrast, sharp/angular edge gradients. These patches cover a high relative spatial area compared to the lighter interstitial regions, featuring jagged, pointed vertex protrusions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-tan topological graph. Junctions are primarily tri-valent and quadri-valent nodes. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel width throughout the flank, providing clear separation between all adjacent dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a high-frequency serrated profile along the visible neck line, characterized by short, dark, vertically-oriented hair bundles creating a jagged 1D contour.
